heading "You said:" [level=4]
    - paragraph: Invent a reusable, robot-deployable temporary anchor for existing rough surfaces without an installed receiver. The useful operation is to approach an ordinary wall patch, find and establish load-bearing contacts, qualify a useful fixture load from actual observations, hold it without an external holding supply, transfer it to paid support, release and restore the same head. This would let maintenance and construction tools use structures that have not been manufactured as robot docking stations. A larger ideal contact array or a static force allocation is not that invention.

Select actual commercial products and two independently manufactured lots per family. Use their as-received faces without machining a mating pattern, drilling, intentional roughening or installing fasteners. Dry brushing or other non-transformative preparation is allowed if its equipment, time, energy, waste and surface effects are paid. State a measurable admissible envelope for texture, macro-flatness, moisture, dust, loose material and pre-existing damage that corresponds to ordinary useful stock rather than hand-picked ideal asperities.
